verdict.rationale: Quo documents call-handling rules that act on incoming-call events: routing calls to the right person, custom ring orders, phone menus, and Sona answering when the team can't. There is no evidence of a general rules or automation engine, so support is limited to narrow telephony routing. Missing for 10: a general event-to-action rule builder, triggers beyond inbound calls (e.g., messages, contacts), configurable action types, webhooks or workflow automation docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
